mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window, or SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.8% over three months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.8%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate contracting consumer demand that lowers corporate revenue expectations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong industrial production growth (INDPRO > 110) signals easing supply constraints that lowers input costs and boosts corporate margins, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110, or Rank IC for INDPRO in high-growth regime < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) signals imminent monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong employment growth (PAYEMS growth > 100k YoY) indicates robust labor market conditions that support consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS growth > 100k YoY, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic weakness that reduces corporate revenue visibility, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term < 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 110) for two months signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profits, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year window.
